selection_basis: Official metadata, access feasibility, and filename/metadata novelty checks; no observed target associations were inspected
selection_order: Start with DEMO_H and one-to-one left join BMX_H and HDL_H by SEQN privately
Women 20-44 require RIDEXPRG=2; other women exclude RIDEXPRG=1
retained_values: Preserve released outcome values exactly. No outlier trimming, winsorization, transformation, model fitting, or target distribution summary during preparation.
age_definition: Completed years at screening; the 80-plus topcode is excluded
pregnancy_limitation: Released pregnancy ascertainment is limited to women 20-44; this rule does not establish nonpregnancy at all ages
no_fasting_restriction: HDL is an examination-sample assay; use WTMEC2YR, not fasting-subsample weights
no_disease_or_treatment_exclusions: No diabetes, lipid therapy, smoking or alcohol information is supplied or used for eligibility
full_design_spine: All DEMO_H records with positive finite WTMEC2YR; SDMVSTRA and SDMVPSU retained privately with domain membership
complete_case_limitation: A paired complete-case benchmark; source weights do not automatically correct remaining item nonresponse
blinding: Procedural role separation, checksum locks and read-only files; shared filesystem is not an access-control sandbox

metadata_search.scope: biomedical_research filename inventory; contents limited to JSON, manifest, metadata and README candidates
metadata_search.qualification: No prior exact-case analysis was found by this check; this is not proof that no broader workspace document ever mentions the cycle
